audit_target: Dataset Split Consistency Verification between Locked Splits, Phase 5/6, and Phase 7

counts_in_stratified_locked_audit.algorithm: patient_level_stratified_split (Deterministic Greedy Multi-Label Patient-Grouped Stratification, seed 42)

discrepancy_explanation.detailed_cause: The 1,731 / 374 / 364 partition cited was from the early Phase 2/3 initial unstratified random patient shuffle (recorded in split_quality_report.md). That initial split was flagged in split_quality_report.json for severe class imbalance (only 2 Oral Cancer images in validation). Phase 3 replaced it with a class-stratified patient-grouped algorithm (recorded in stratified_split_quality_report.md and research_notes.md), resulting in 1,726 / 372 / 371. The 1,726 / 372 / 371 split was committed directly into results/splits/train_split.json, val_split.json, and test_split.json. Baseline training in Phase 5 and evaluation in Phase 6 used this 371-image test set. Phase 7 correctly and consistently loaded these exact files.
discrepancy_explanation.leakage_warning_if_364_were_used: 35 of the 50 patients in the obsolete 364-image unstratified test set are present in the 1,726 training set used to train the Phase 5 neural weights. Evaluating the trained models on the 364-image set would introduce 70% patient leakage into test evaluation.

summary.exclusion_reason: Normal oral mucosal images do not contain pathological lesions or expert polygon annotations.
summary.patient_overlap: Zero train/test leakage (0%). 100% agreement between Phase 7 and results/splits/test_split.json (49/49 patients).
